d:
Long, silky silver-grey hair with soft waves and straight bangs. Calm, gentle light blue eyes with a serene expression. Appears to be a mid-teenager with a soft, youthful face. Slender, petite build. A white and navy blue sailor-style outfit with short sleeves and a short pleated skirt. Includes a white sailor cap and a traditional Japanese katana sheathed at the hip.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
